mathematical_condition.compatible_worlds: W[o,d] = {w in W : O(w) = o and D(w) = d}
required: W[o,d] is nonempty under the frozen finite domain model
{T(w) : w in W[o,d]} has exactly one value under that model
mathematical_condition.not_claimed: enumeration or authentication of all real-world histories

ablation_classifications.NECESSARY_IN_THIS_BUNDLE: A lawful reduction under unchanged observation, target and trust becomes UNRESOLVED.
ablation_classifications.REDUNDANT_IN_THIS_BUNDLE: A lawful reduction preserves the same scoped target truth.
ablation_classifications.UNTESTED: A comparable lawful reduction was not supplied or run.
ablation_classifications.INVALID_ABLATION: The reduction changes frozen scope or trust, is unauthenticated, conflicts, or is not the declared unit deletion.

hash.encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false

non_claims: A content hash is not a signature or an independent source authentication.
An enrolled-key signature authenticates an assertion, not physical or publication history.
One-step information irreducibility is not global evidence minimality.
No QualificationReceipt, CurrentUseBinding, or AuthorizationGrant is issued.
